systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: INTERPOL's SIPAO programme with the national authorities; financed by the European Union
systems.tiers: a data collection and registration centre (DACORE) not yet inaugurated at December 2022: inauguration was planned for January 2023, 14 DACORE staff were trained from 26 September to 14 October 2022, and computer equipment was handed over on 19 October 2022

systems.system: Système automatisé de reconnaissance d'empreintes digitales (AFIS)
systems.platform: AFIS, a component of the SIPAO programme
systems.owner: INTERPOL's AFIS project, financed by the European Union
systems.tiers: none: the project's steering committee of 21 July 2022 placed Guinea-Bissau among the countries to be prepared for an AFIS under a possible future action

note: INTERPOL's SIPAO newsletter of December 2022 reports for Guinea-Bissau a programme delegation received by the President on 19 October 2022, equipment handed over, user training begun and the data centre due to open in January 2023; SIPAO is described as electronic criminal databases shared nationally, regionally and globally, and nothing says stations enter reports or cases, so no fact. The programme-wide figures (14 of 16 centres operational, about 500,000 police records) are not given by country.
